name: openai/gpt-5.1-codex
description: GPT-5.1-Codex is a version of OpenAI's GPT-5.1 optimized for agentic coding in Codex and similar environments, released in November 2025 with text and image input and text output. It targets autonomous, long-running software engineering work inside coding agents and tools, and OpenAI notes its underlying snapshot is updated over time. Pick it over general GPT-5.1 when building coding agents; OpenAI serves it through the Responses API only.
